instruction:
Convert this REST endpoint description to an OpenAPI 3.0 path item (YAML):

GET /users - lists users, query params: page (int), limit (int, default 20). Returns 200 with an array of user objects {id, name, email}.
output:
/users:
    get:
      operationId: listUsers
      parameters:
        - name: page
          in: query
          schema: { type: integer }
        - name: limit
          in: query
          schema: { type: integer, default: 20 }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: A list of users
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: "#/components/schemas/User"

instruction:
Convert this REST endpoint description to an OpenAPI 3.0 path item (YAML):

POST /users - creates a user. Body: {name: string, email: string}. Returns 201 with the created user including id.
output:
/users:
    post:
      operationId: createUser
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [name, email]
              properties:
                name: { type: string }
                email: { type: string, format: email }
      responses:
        "201":
          description: User created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/User"

instruction:
Convert this REST endpoint description to an OpenAPI 3.0 path item (YAML):

GET /users/{id} - fetch one user by numeric path id. 404 if missing.
output:
/users/{id}:
    get:
      operationId: getUser
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: integer }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: The user
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/User"
        "404":
          description: User not found

instruction:
Convert this REST endpoint description to an OpenAPI 3.0 path item (YAML):

DELETE /users/{id} - deletes a user, returns 204 with no content.
output:
/users/{id}:
    delete:
      operationId: deleteUser
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: integer }
      responses:
        "204":
          description: Deleted

instruction:
Convert this REST endpoint description to an OpenAPI 3.0 path item (YAML):

PATCH /users/{id} - partial update. Body may contain name and/or email. Returns the updated user.
output:
/users/{id}:
    patch:
      operationId: updateUser
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: integer }
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                name: { type: string }
                email: { type: string, format: email }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Updated user
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/User"

instruction:
Convert this REST description to an OpenAPI 3.0 paths section (YAML):

GET /health - public health check returning {status: string}. POST /auth/login - body {email, password}, returns {token, expires_in}.
output:
/health:
    get:
      operationId: health
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Service status
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  status: { type: string }
  /auth/login:
    post:
      operationId: login
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [email, password]
              properties:
                email: { type: string }
                password: { type: string, format: password }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: JWT issued
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  token: { type: string }
                  expires_in: { type: integer }

instruction:
Convert this REST endpoint description to an OpenAPI 3.0 path item with bearer auth (YAML):

GET /orders - requires Authorization: Bearer <jwt>. Query: status (enum: open, closed, cancelled). Returns array of orders.
output:
/orders:
    get:
      operationId: listOrders
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - name: status
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
            enum: [open, closed, cancelled]
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Orders for the caller
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: "#/components/schemas/Order"

instruction:
Convert this REST endpoint description to an OpenAPI 3.0 path item with nested resource (YAML):

GET /users/{userId}/orders/{orderId} - fetch a single order belonging to a user. Both ids are strings.
output:
/users/{userId}/orders/{orderId}:
    get:
      operationId: getUserOrder
      parameters:
        - name: userId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string }
        - name: orderId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: The order
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Order"
        "404":
          description: Not found

instruction:
Convert this REST endpoint description to an OpenAPI 3.0 operation with pagination headers (YAML):

GET /events - returns 200 with Link-style pagination. Response headers: X-Total-Count (int), X-Next-Cursor (string).
output:
/events:
    get:
      operationId: listEvents
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Event page
          headers:
            X-Total-Count:
              schema: { type: integer }
            X-Next-Cursor:
              schema: { type: string }
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
            type: array
              items:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Event"

instruction:
Convert this REST endpoint description to an OpenAPI 3.0 operation with file upload (YAML):

POST /uploads - multipart/form-data with a required file field and an optional name field. Returns 201 with {id, url}.
output:
/uploads:
    post:
      operationId: uploadFile
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          multipart/form-data:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [file]
              properties:
                file:
                  type: string
                  format: binary
                name:
                  type: string
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Uploaded
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  id: { type: string }
                  url: { type: string, format: uri }

instruction:
Convert this REST search description to an OpenAPI 3.0 operation (YAML):

GET /search - full-text search. Query: q (required string), limit (int, default 10), offset (int, default 0). Returns {total, results[]}.
output:
/search:
    get:
      operationId: search
      parameters:
        - name: q
          in: query
          required: true
          schema: { type: string }
        - name: limit
          in: query
          schema: { type: integer, default: 10 }
        - name: offset
          in: query
          schema: { type: integer, default: 0 }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Search results
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  total: { type: integer }
                  results:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      $ref: "#/components/schemas/Result"

instruction:
Convert this REST endpoint description to an OpenAPI 3.0 operation returning XML or JSON (YAML):

GET /reports/summary - returns summary numbers. Content types: application/json and application/xml.
output:
/reports/summary:
    get:
      operationId: reportSummary
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Summary report
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Summary"
            application/xml:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Summary"

instruction:
Convert this REST webhook description to an OpenAPI 3.0 path item (YAML):

POST /webhooks/incoming - receives {event: string, data: object}. Responds 200 {received: true} or 400 on invalid payload.
output:
/webhooks/incoming:
    post:
      operationId: incomingWebhook
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [event, data]
              properties:
                event: { type: string }
                data: { type: object }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Accepted
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  received: { type: boolean }
        "400":
          description: Invalid payload

instruction:
Convert this REST endpoint description to an OpenAPI 3.0 operation with rate-limit headers (YAML):

GET /pricing - public pricing tiers. Responses include headers X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining (ints), and 429 when exceeded.
output:
/pricing:
    get:
      operationId: getPricing
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Pricing tiers
          headers:
            X-RateLimit-Limit:
              schema: { type: integer }
            X-RateLimit-Remaining:
              schema: { type: integer }
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: "#/components/schemas/PricingTier"
        "429":
          description: Too many requests

instruction:
Convert this REST API description to a minimal OpenAPI 3.0 document with info and servers (YAML):

Base URL: https://api.example.com/v2. Name: Inventory API, version 1.0.0. Endpoints: GET /items, GET /items/{sku}.
output:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Inventory API
  version: 1.0.0
servers:
  - url: https://api.example.com/v2
paths:
  /items:
    get:
      operationId: listItems
      responses:
        "200":
          description: All items
  /items/{sku}:
    get:
      operationId: getItem
      parameters:
        - name: sku
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: One item
        "404":
          description: Unknown sku

instruction:
Convert this REST description with api-key auth to an OpenAPI 3.0 operation (YAML):

GET /export.csv - streams a CSV export. Requires header X-API-Key. Returns text/csv.
output:
/export.csv:
    get:
      operationId: exportCsv
      security:
        - apiKeyAuth: []
      responses:
        "200":
          description: CSV export
          content:
            text/csv:
              schema:
                type: string

instruction:
Convert this REST description to an OpenAPI 3.0 operation with date range query params (YAML):

GET /metrics - query: from (date, required), to (date, required), granularity (enum: hour, day). Returns {series: [{t, v}]}.
output:
/metrics:
    get:
      operationId: getMetrics
      parameters:
        - name: from
          in: query
          required: true
          schema: { type: string, format: date }
        - name: to
          in: query
          required: true
          schema: { type: string, format: date }
        - name: granularity
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
            enum: [hour, day]
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Metric series
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  series:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      type: object
                      properties:
                        t: { type: string, format: date-time }
                        v: { type: number }

instruction:
Convert this REST batch endpoint description to an OpenAPI 3.0 operation (JSON):

POST /users/bulk - body is an array of {name, email}. Returns 207 with {created: [], errors: []}.
output:
/users/bulk:
    post:
      operationId: bulkCreateUsers
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: array
              items:
                type: object
                required: [name, email]
                properties:
                  name: { type: string }
                  email: { type: string, format: email }
      responses:
        "207":
          description: Multi-status result
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  created:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      $ref: "#/components/schemas/User"
                  errors:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      type: object
                      properties:
                        index: { type: integer }
                        message: { type: string }

instruction:
Convert this REST SSE endpoint description to an OpenAPI 3.0 operation (YAML):

GET /stream - server-sent events of type message with JSON data. Responds 200 with content type text/event-stream.
output:
/stream:
    get:
      operationId: streamEvents
      responses:
        "200":
          description: SSE stream
          content:
            text/event-stream:
              schema:
                type: string

instruction:
Convert this REST endpoint description to an OpenAPI 3.0 operation with OAuth2 security (YAML):

PUT /projects/{id} - update project name. Auth: OAuth2 clientCredentials scope projects:write. Body: {name: string}. Returns the project.
output:
/projects/{id}:
    put:
      operationId: updateProject
      security:
        - oauth2: [projects:write]
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string }
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [name]
              properties:
                name: { type: string }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Updated project
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Project"
